pages.text: This pack has trains, airships, submarines, rockets and roller coasters. Each one has places that are worth reaching with it. This entry is the map of who goes where.

$(bold)Trains$() link your bases and farms over long distances. Create: Power Loader can keep a station's area loaded.$(br2)$(l:transport/trains)Trains$(/l), $(l:industry/power_loader)Power Loader$(/l).

$(bold)Airships$() reach sky villages, floating ruins and soaring structures that you can't easily climb to. Watch out for Hostile Skies' raiders and the cold of altitude.$(br2)$(l:flight/destinations)Flight Destinations$(/l).

$(bold)Space:$() a Northstar rocket goes to the Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus. An Aeronautics ship can make the jump too with a Dimensional Drive (or the Stellar Navigator). Every way up needs a $(l:stars/why)Stellar Core$(/l).$(br2)$(l:space/reaching_space)Reaching Space$(/l), $(l:space/aeronautics_bridge)Ships to Space$(/l).

$(bold)Submarines$() reach ruins, shipwrecks, ocean monuments and the deep, where pressure and air become the problem.$(br2)$(l:ocean/submarines)Submarines$(/l), $(l:ocean/underwater_places)Underwater Places$(/l).
$(bold)Roller coasters$() go nowhere in particular. That is the point.$(br2)$(l:transport/coasters)Roller Coasters$(/l).
